description.zh:
給定一個非負整數 \( n \)，印出第 \( n \) 個斐波那契數。 為此，請編寫一個函式 fib(n)，該函式接受非負整數 \( n \) 並傳回第 \( n \) 個斐波那契數。

不要使用迴圈，而使用遞迴的天賦。 但是，您應該考慮為什麼遞迴方法比使用迴圈慢得多。

Java 注意： 請在 Main 類別中撰寫 static 方法，由 main 讀取輸入、呼叫方法並輸出結果；遞迴題不得以迴圈取代。
description.en:
Given a non-negative integer \( n \), print the \( n \)th Fibonacci number. Do this by writing a function fib(n) which takes the non-negative integer \( n \) and returns the \( n \)th Fibonacci number.

Don't use loops, use the flair of recursion instead. However, you should think about why the recursive method is much slower than using loops.

Java note: Write a static method in Main and call it from main. Do not replace recursion with a loop in recursion exercises.

hint.zh: 請在 Main 類別中撰寫 static 方法，由 main 讀取輸入、呼叫方法並輸出結果；遞迴題不得以迴圈取代。
hint.en: Write a static method in Main and call it from main. Do not replace recursion with a loop in recursion exercises.
